text:
Tyler G: Heads-up — ACME wants to kick off a private/on‑prem POC next Tue. They asked for a preflight checklist (network, KMS, VPN, drivers, k8s). Also asked if Dedicated pricing applies during POC and what happens if we have to fall back to hosted. Who can own the technical preflight answers and a short note for their security team?
Priya S: I can own the preflight. Quick Qs: are their nodes air‑gapped or outbound‑allowed? and which GPU SKUs?
Tyler G: Not airgapped, egress allowed to our control plane. GPUs are A100-40GB (primary) + a couple of T4s for batch. I'll DM the asset list.
Alex W: Driver/CUDA minimum guidance for A100: recommend driver >= 510 but prefer 520+. CUDA 11.7+ is supported; CUDA 12+ is okay but warn about custom builds. Tell them to run these checks and paste output:
```
nvidia-smi
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
kubectl get nodes -o wide
uname -r
```
Priya S: Nice — add that we need kubelet >= 1.25 and containerd >= 1.6 for our installer. Also need iptables legacy mode on some distros (or nft compatible config).
Maria L: KMS: for Private we prefer customer‑managed keys. Customer should provide an AWS KMS ARN + IAM role (sts:AssumeRole) or Azure KeyVault details. We need the ARN and the role trust policy. For transport, we support VPN or VPC peering; if they use VPN please confirm route propagation and that our control-plane CIDRs are reachable. (I'll send a short template).
Jordan K: Security questionnaire highlights: data at rest can be encrypted with customer KMS; audit logs can be forwarded to their S3/CloudStorage. Models run in their cluster — weights don't leave their VPC in Private mode. I'll prepare Q&A for the questionnaire (short answers + references).
FieldEngBot: Preflight checklist draft created: https://internal.redwood/fieldeng/preflight/1876543210 (contains driver checks, kube requirements, network ports).
Priya S: For network ports: outbound to control plane (TCP 443) + optional inbound for ops ssh if they want us to run the installer. We'll request a temporary bastion jumpbox rather than opening SSH to worker nodes.
SalesOps: Pricing note — POC can run on Hosted (trial credits) or Dedicated (reserved). If they run Private and we fall back to Hosted during a capacity event, hosted usage is billed at hosted rates; Sales can issue a one‑time courtesy credit up to $5k for the POC on request. Confirm with the customer before committing.
Tyler G: Great. Action items: Priya — send the short preflight checklist + the nvidia/k8s commands to ACME and ask for node outputs. Alex — paste the driver note and sample commands in that message. Maria/Jordan — I'll attach KMS template and the security Q&A. SalesOps — pls confirm POC credit terms in the reply thread so I can include it in the proposal.
Alex W: Pasted driver snippet below for copy/paste into email:
"We require NVIDIA driver >= 510 (520 recommended). Please run `nvidia-smi` and include the kernel and driver version. If you have custom kernels or older CentOS/RHEL, we may need DKMS or a reboot during install."
Priya S: I'll compile everything and send to ACME today. tagging @Maria L for the KMS template. :thumbsup:
Tyler G: Thank you all — once we have node outputs and KMS ARN I'll schedule a quick 30m preflight call with ACME and field eng.
Maria L: Sending KMS template now (will DM link).
SalesOps: Confirmed POC credit option on record.
Tyler G: Closing loop — I'll post the customer message here when sent.
